question: Why can admin not update Messages (404) in UntisX (endpoint /absences)?
answer: Check role admin. Module Messages may require higher permissions. Error 404: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /absences and the database connection. Feature Messages must be enabled.
